<title level="1" right="Action">[Death From Above](/Actions.aspx?ID=2782) <actions string="Single Action" /></title>

<traits>
<trait label="Flourish" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=606" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 91

**Requirements** The flying squirrel is above the target

</column>

---

The flying squirrel crashes down onto a target, furiously clawing at it. The flying squirrel falls to an empty space next to the target, taking no damage, and makes two claw Strikes. Both attacks count toward its [multiple attack penalty](/Rules.aspx?ID=2289), but the penalty doesn’t increase until after both attacks have been made.
name: Death From Above
requirement: The flying squirrel is above the target
